stories.headline: Google orders 3M+ TPUs from Intel Foundry for 2028; Nvidia tests Intel 18A as TSMC backup

key_facts.fact: Google has placed a firm order with Intel Foundry to manufacture more than 3 million in-house Tensor Processing Units in 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Google has placed an order with Intel to manufacture more than three million of its in-house tensor processing units in 2028… The Information reported on Monday, citing four people with direct knowledge of the talks.

key_facts.fact: Morgan Stanley estimates Google's full TPU build-out across 2027 and 2028 exceeds 6 million units, so the Intel order covers roughly half of 2028 output.
key_facts.excerpt: Morgan Stanley estimates Google's total TPU buildout across 2027 and 2028 exceeds six million units, suggesting the Intel order covers a substantial share of that pipeline.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia is running early multi-project wafer trials on Intel's 18A process to evaluate whether Intel can build a processor that fuses four GPU dies into one package, tied to Nvidia's Feynman GPU architecture due in 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia has not committed. It is running early trials, including multiproject wafer runs on 18A, and testing whether Intel can build a processor that fuses four graphics chips into one, a design tied to its Feynman GPU architecture due in 2028.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix is testing whether its high-bandwidth memory works reliably with Intel's advanced packaging.
key_facts.excerpt: SK Hynix is reportedly testing whether its high-bandwidth memory works reliably with Intel's packaging too.

key_facts.fact: Intel shares jumped roughly 11-12% on the news, trading near $109-$111 and pushing market cap to about $557 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel shares surged roughly 12% on the news, trading near $110.81 with a market cap of approximately $557 billion.

key_facts.fact: Google is already selling TPU computing access to outside customers including Apple and Meta, reinforcing the in-house silicon strategy that lowers reliance on Nvidia.
key_facts.excerpt: Currently, Google has begun selling TPU computing power to companies like Apple and Meta Platforms.

stories.headline: Amazon signs multibillion-dollar Corning fiber deal to wire US AI data centers, adding 1,000 jobs

key_facts.fact: Amazon announced a multiyear, multibillion-dollar agreement with Corning to supply optical fiber, cable and connectivity for its expanding US data center infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, Amazon announced a multibillion-dollar agreement with Corning Incorporated, a leading manufacturer of advanced glass and fiber optic technology, to supply the optical fiber, cable, and connectivity solutions that power Amazon's expanding data center infrastructure across the United States.

key_facts.fact: The deal creates 1,000 new advanced manufacturing jobs at Corning's North Carolina facilities, plus hundreds of construction jobs to expand those plants.
key_facts.excerpt: The investment will create 1,000 new, highly skilled jobs at Corning's manufacturing facilities across North Carolina, and support hundreds of additional construction jobs to expand Corning's facilities.

key_facts.fact: Corning shares rose roughly 7-8% on the announcement; the company's stock has more than doubled in 2026 and is up nearly sixfold since end-2023.
key_facts.excerpt: Corning's stock has more than doubled this year and is up almost sixfold since the end of 2023.

key_facts.fact: The Amazon agreement follows up to $6B from Meta in January and up to $3.2B from Nvidia in May, the latter to build three Corning plants dedicated to the chipmaker.
key_facts.excerpt: The Amazon agreement follows up to $6bn from Meta in January and up to $3.2bn from Nvidia in May, the latter to build three plants dedicated entirely to the chipmaker.

key_facts.fact: Corning has previously announced plans to increase US-based optical connectivity manufacturing capacity tenfold and expand domestic fiber production capacity by more than 50%.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has already announced plans to increase U.S.-based optical connectivity manufacturing capacity tenfold and expand domestic fiber production capacity by more than 50%.

key_facts.fact: Amazon is spending roughly $200B on AI data center infrastructure this year and has committed $10B to North Carolina data centers alone.
key_facts.excerpt: The company is spending around $200bn this year on the data centres, chips, and networking behind its AI push, having pledged $10bn for North Carolina data centres alone and committed up to $25bn to Anthropic to lock in demand for that capacity.

stories.headline: China drafts $295B five-year plan for AI data centers, 80%+ tech from local suppliers like Huawei

key_facts.fact: China is preparing to spend roughly 2 trillion yuan (about $295 billion) over the next five years on a nationwide network of AI data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: China is planning to spend around 2 trillion yuan ($295 billion) over the next five years on a nationwide network of data centers, as Beijing pushes to accelerate its domestic AI industry and close the gap with the United States, Bloomberg reported Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: The blueprint, drafted by agencies including the National Development and Reform Commission, would have state-owned firms such as China Mobile and China Telecom operate the bulk of the facilities and ensure they are interconnected.
key_facts.excerpt: Government agencies including the National Development and Reform Commission are drafting a plan to build interconnected computing hubs across the country, according to Bloomberg. State-owned firms such as China Mobile (HK:0941) and China Telecom (HK:0728) would operate the bulk of the facilities and ensure they are linked together.

key_facts.fact: At least 80% of the technology used, including AI chips, would come from domestic suppliers such as Huawei, effectively shutting out Nvidia and AMD.
key_facts.excerpt: At least 80% of the technology used — including AI chips — would come from domestic suppliers such as Huawei, effectively shutting out Nvidia and AMD.

key_facts.fact: Funding would come primarily from sovereign debt, including ultra-long-term special government bonds, plus state investment funds, with bank loans and private capital providing additional financing.
key_facts.excerpt: Funding would come primarily through sovereign debt, including ultra-long-term special government bonds, as well as state investment funds, with bank loans and private capital providing additional financing.

key_facts.fact: The broader goal is to connect China's scattered data infrastructure into a unified network by 2028; when power grid integration is factored in, total projected investment could reach at least 5 trillion yuan.
key_facts.excerpt: The broader goal is to connect China's scattered data infrastructure into a unified network by 2028, furthering the country's push to deploy AI across public sectors including healthcare, transportation and urban management. When power grid integration is factored in, total projected investment could reach at least 5 trillion yuan, the report said.

key_facts.fact: The 2 trillion yuan figure excludes spending by private Chinese firms such as Alibaba and Tencent and is set against $700B+ that US Big Tech is expected to spend on AI buildout this year.
key_facts.excerpt: This comes as Big Tech companies in the U.S. are expected to spend more than $700 billion this year to fund their AI buildout plans.

stories.headline: Meta launches $115M America's Workforce Academy with job guarantees to staff AI data center buildout

key_facts.fact: Meta is committing $115 million in the first year to America's Workforce Academy, a free skilled-trades training program with a guaranteed job for every graduate.
key_facts.excerpt: The parent company of Facebook and Instagram is creating the America's Workforce Academy (AWA) with an initial investment of $115 million in the program's first year. It will start with pilot locations in Louisiana, Ohio, Indiana and Texas this year.

key_facts.fact: Meta calls it the largest private-sector commitment to skilled trades training with a job guarantee in US history.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta said in its announcement that this initiative is the largest private-sector commitment to the skilled trades with a job guarantee in U.S. history.

key_facts.fact: The four- to five-week bootcamp covers power generation, grid modernization and data center construction; pilots launch in Indianapolis, Baton Rouge, Houston and Columbus, with the first cohort in Baton Rouge.
key_facts.excerpt: America's Workforce Academy will teach workers about 'power generation, grid modernization and data center construction.' … The academy will be operated in four U.S. cities — Indianapolis, Indiana; Baton Rouge, Louisiana; Houston, Texas; and Columbus, Ohio. The academy's first cohort will be trained in Baton Rouge.

key_facts.fact: Meta covers tuition, airfare, lodging and pays a daily stipend; graduates earn an NCCER credential plus an America's Workforce Certificate, both portable across employers.
key_facts.excerpt: Graduates will receive two credentials after training with the academy, with one from the National Center for Construction Education and Research (NCCER) and an America's Workforce Certificate, all without paying a single dollar.

key_facts.fact: Meta says it expects to extend roughly 3,300 job offers to graduates in the program's first year; partners include Associated Builders and Contractors and CBRE.
key_facts.excerpt: We're launching in Louisiana, Ohio, Indiana, and Texas in 2026, partnering with Associated Builders and Contractors and CBRE to deliver this at scale. In our first year, we expect to extend approximately 3,300 job offers to graduates.

key_facts.fact: The program lands amid a US construction shortage of roughly 349,000 workers this year and follows Meta's recent layoff of 8,000 employees.
key_facts.excerpt: By one estimate, the construction industry is short 349,000 new workers this year amid surging investment in AI infrastructure, and data center projects tend to create more temporary than permanent positions. Last month, Meta laid off 8,000 workers amid heavy spending on artificial intelligence.

stories.headline: Finnish SAR satellite maker Iceye raises €1B at €10B valuation, quadrupling six-month-old mark

key_facts.fact: Iceye raised €450M ($520M) in a primary Series F round led by General Atlantic at a valuation of over €10B (over $12B); including a secondary placement, the total transaction exceeds €1B.
key_facts.excerpt: ICEYE, the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space, has raised EUR 450 million (USD 520 million) in a primary Series F funding round led by General Atlantic, at a valuation of over EUR 10 billion (over USD 12 billion). … Together with a secondary placement, the total fundraising round exceeds EUR 1 billion.

key_facts.fact: The €10B valuation is roughly four times the €2.4-2.5B mark set six months ago, when General Catalyst led a €200M round.
key_facts.excerpt: Notably this is a big leap in the company's valuation, which was a more modest €2.5 billion just six months ago when General Catalyst led a €200 million round in the startup.

key_facts.fact: New investors include Qatar Investment Authority, TCV and Nokia as a strategic investor, alongside Finnish state funds Solidium, Tesi, Varma and Ilmarinen plus existing backer Lifeline Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: Additional investors include Solidium, Tesi, Varma, Ilmarinen, Lifeline Ventures, as well as Nokia, from Finland, Qatar Investment Authority (QIA), and TCV.

key_facts.fact: The €450M primary tranche is one of the largest single venture rounds for a European defence technology company.
key_facts.excerpt: The €450 million primary round is one of the largest single venture rounds for a European defence technology company.

key_facts.fact: Iceye operates the world's largest synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite constellation; in 2025 it surpassed €250M in revenue and €100M in EBITDA.
key_facts.excerpt: This funding round follows ICEYE's delivery of a sovereign satellite constellation to the Polish Armed Forces in less than a year. The company also surpassed €250 million in revenue and €100 million in EBITDA in 2025.

key_facts.fact: Iceye was founded in Finland in 2014 and now has more than 1,000 employees globally.
key_facts.excerpt: Natively European, founded in Finland. ICEYE operates globally with over 1,000 employees.

stories.headline: Franco-Ukrainian AI air-defense startup Alta Ares raises €50M Series A to scale drone interceptors

key_facts.fact: Alta Ares raised a €50M Series A led by Air Street Capital, with Cherry Ventures, OTB Ventures and Harpoon Ventures participating.
key_facts.excerpt: Alta Ares, the French startup building AI-powered air defence systems, has raised a €50m Series A to ramp up the production of its technology. The round was led by European solo GP fund Air Street Capital, and included London-based investor Cherry Ventures, Polish VC OTB Ventures and US firm Harpoon Ventures.

key_facts.fact: The startup, founded in 2024, builds AI-powered systems to detect, identify and intercept enemy drones and missiles, and says its products are already deployed in active conflict zones in Europe and the Middle East.
key_facts.excerpt: Alta Ares, which launched at the start of 2024, is building systems that can detect, identify and intercept enemy aircraft, as well as the AI software suite to power those systems. Alta Ares says it differentiates itself from competitors because its products are currently deployed in active conflict zones, including in Europe and the Middle East.

key_facts.fact: Co-founder and CEO Hadrien Canter says three teams are working with militaries in three conflict zones where Alta Ares systems are currently intercepting targets.
key_facts.excerpt: 'We're operationally deployed right now, which is not the case of every hot player in the game,' says Hadrien Canter, cofounder and CEO of Alta Ares. 'We have three teams working with the military in three conflict zones, where our systems are currently intercepting.'

key_facts.fact: Alta Ares operates two interceptor classes: a short-range system aimed at Iranian Shahed-style drones and a medium-range interceptor for cruise missiles and glide bombs.
key_facts.excerpt: Alta Ares develops one system designed for a short-range radius and specialising in intercepting threats like Iranian Shahed drones, and another medium-range interceptor designed for cruise missiles and glide bombs.

key_facts.fact: The €50M will be used mainly to scale production, plus hiring and international expansion across France and Ukraine.
key_facts.excerpt: Les 50 millions d'euros levés par Alta Ares financeront des recrutements, le développement international de la société et le renforcement de ses capacités industrielles en France et en Ukraine.

key_facts.fact: Alta Ares' product stack includes Pixel Lock for embedded detection and tracking, Gamma for autonomous interceptor guidance, X-Lock for short-range drone interception and Black Bird for faster aerial threats; in early 2026 it tested Black Bird at -25°C in Estonia, reaching 450 km/h.
key_facts.excerpt: Its stack includes Pixel Lock for embedded detection, tracking, and terminal guidance; Gamma for autonomous interceptor guidance; X-Lock for short-range drone interception; and Black Bird for faster aerial threats. … The company reported three consecutive flights, ground temperatures of -17 degrees Celsius and -25 degrees Celsius at altitude, and a top recorded speed of 450 km/h.

stories.headline: Apple unveils AFM Cloud Pro running on Nvidia Blackwell B200 GPUs inside Google Cloud at WWDC

key_facts.fact: Apple revealed at WWDC that its most powerful new model, Apple Foundation Model Cloud Pro, will run in the cloud on Nvidia GPUs inside Google Cloud, extending Apple's Private Cloud Compute infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple AI executive Amar Subramanya said that AFM Cloud Pro is comparable to Google's Gemini frontier models. It will run in the cloud on Nvidia GPUs, which are part of Apple's Private Cloud Compute infrastructure, Apple officials said.

key_facts.fact: The cloud tier uses Nvidia Blackwell B200 GPUs and turns on Nvidia's confidential computing feature, which encrypts data while it is being processed on the chip.
key_facts.excerpt: The rebuilt Siri runs on a custom 1.2-trillion-parameter model built on Google's Gemini technology, hosted on Google Cloud servers powered by Nvidia Blackwell B200 GPUs. … Nvidia's confidential computing feature encrypts data while it is being processed on the Blackwell GPUs, adding a hardware-level safeguard on top of the contractual one.

key_facts.fact: AFM Cloud Pro is the only one of Apple's five new foundation models optimized for Nvidia GPUs instead of Apple Silicon, and adds roughly 10% in text response quality, 14% in image understanding and 14% on math tasks over AFM Cloud.
key_facts.excerpt: AFM 3 Cloud Pro is the most powerful server model for the most demanding use cases: agentic tool use and complex reasoning. Compared with AFM 3 Cloud, it adds another roughly 10 percent in response quality for text and 14 percent in image understanding; on math tasks it gains 14 percent. Notably, as the only one of the five models, AFM 3 Cloud Pro was optimized not for Apple Silicon but for NVIDIA GPUs.

key_facts.fact: Apple says it routes Siri queries through three tiers: simple tasks on-device, moderate ones to Apple's Private Cloud Compute servers, and the heaviest to Nvidia GPUs in Google Cloud, with requests "never stored" and inaccessible to anyone.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple now routes Siri queries through three layers. Simple tasks stay on-device using Apple's own models. Moderately complex requests go to Apple's Private Cloud Compute servers. … 'We use none of the models that Google deploys to its customers,' software chief Craig Federighi said at a WWDC media event. 'Your requests are completely private to you. They're never stored. They're never accessible to anyone.'

key_facts.fact: This marks Apple's first use of Nvidia chips in roughly a decade, with training done on Google's cloud TPUs while serving runs on Nvidia GPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: While Apple and Nvidia have a history… it is the first time that the company has [used Nvidia chips in years].

key_facts.fact: Apple's contract reportedly bars Google from training future models on Apple user data, and Apple says Google receives no Apple user data through the arrangement.
key_facts.excerpt: Crucial to the privacy story Apple is determined to keep: user data would 'never be stored or shared — not even with Apple,' and Google confirmed that it receives no Apple user data.
